result.summary: Found 1 minor issue: inconsistent dash character usage in delivery time labels, creating a small visual and content consistency problem.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, delivery time ranges use inconsistent dash characters: '15–25 min' and '20–30 min' (Trattoria Piccolo) use an en dash, while '20-30 min' (Smash Bros Burgers) uses a hyphen minus. This creates a subtle visual and content consistency issue.
issues.suggestion: Standardize all delivery time ranges to use the same dash character (either consistently en dash or hyphen minus) across all restaurant cards for uniformity.
